description: Payroll diversion: employee impersonation from a lookalike-free external freemail account requesting direct-deposit change, steering away from the HR system.

email.subject: Change of bank details for my salary
email.bodyText:
Hi,

I have switched banks and need to update my direct deposit details before this month's payroll run. My old account is being closed at the end of the week.

Please change my payroll deposit to the new account below:

Account name: M Kowalczyk
Sort code: 20-45-77
Account number: 81140293

I tried the self-service HR portal but it keeps rejecting the change, so please just update it on your side. I'm travelling this week so I can't come by the office, email is best.

Could you confirm once it's done so I know it's gone through before the cut-off?

Thanks,
Marta
